description: Return 787daily articles that mention a specific named entity (person, organization, or place), newest-first. Match is on the entity's full canonical name; case and accents are ignored ('jenniffer gonzalez' finds Jenniffer González). Returns { name, count, articles[] }.

name.description: Entity name to search for, e.g. 'LUMA Energy', 'Jenniffer González'

name: get_by_entity
